measured_problem: The all-INT8 main graph collapsed on five paired abstention probes. Restoring all four constant-weight layer-0 projections repaired quality but historically measured only 1.44x Qwen throughput and v41 then failed the long-output benchmark.
hypothesis: One constant-weight layer-0 projection, or one functional attention/MLP pair, is the actual quantization-sensitive boundary. Keeping only that boundary in FP32 can preserve quality while restoring the CPU and RSS gates.

diagnostic.passing_profile_requires: 10 of 10 functional passes and zero collapse
diagnostic.selection: Choose the first passing single-matrix profile. If none pass, choose the smaller-graph passing pair. Do not run stage 2 if a single matrix passes.

screen_after_profile_selection: the previously failing long-output benchmark prompt plus matched controls
full_rescreen_authorization: Exactly one full 1400-case rescreen only if the same selected artifact clears the 2x median speed gate, paired bootstrap lower bound, lower active memory, lower peak RSS, TTFT, persistent state, and long-output generation prechecks.
decision_rule: Reject the branch if no bounded precision profile repairs all 10 probes, or if the selected profile remains below 2x. Do not weaken the quality, speed, memory, or repetition gates.
